questions.q: The Java compiler `javac` translates source code into ______, which is executed by the JVM.
o: machine code of the host CPU
questions.e: javac produces platform-independent bytecode (.class files). The JVM interprets or JIT-compiles it for the host machine. MSIL belongs to .NET.

questions.q: Which of the following contains the compiler `javac` along with the tools needed to develop Java programs?
questions.e: The JDK (Java Development Kit) bundles the compiler, debugger and other tools together with the JRE. The JRE alone only runs programs.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about default values in Java.
I. The default value of an instance variable of type `boolean` is `true`.
II. The default value of an instance variable of a reference type is an empty string.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. A boolean instance variable defaults to false, and a reference defaults to null.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the `final` keyword in Java.
I. A `final` class can be extended by a subclass.
II. A `final` method cannot be overridden in a subclass.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only II is correct. A final method cannot be overridden. A final class cannot be extended at all.

questions.q: Which method is called first in the life cycle of a Java applet?
questions.e: The order is init(), start(), paint(), then stop() and destroy() at the end. init() runs once when the applet is loaded.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a primitive data type in Java?
questions.e: String is a class in java.lang. The eight primitives are byte, short, int, long, float, double, char and boolean.

questions.q: Java supports a form of multiple inheritance through ______.
questions.e: A class can extend only one class but may implement any number of interfaces, which gives Java multiple inheritance of type.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the servlet life cycle.
I. The `init()` method is called only once, when the servlet is first created.
II. The `destroy()` method is called only once, before the servlet is removed.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are true. init() and destroy() are called once each, whereas service() is called for every request.

questions.q: What is the full form of JDBC?
questions.e: JDBC stands for Java Database Connectivity, the API used to connect Java programs to relational databases.

questions.q: A thread that has been created with `new Thread()` but on which `start()` has not yet been called is in the ______ state.
questions.e: A freshly created thread is in the NEW state. It becomes RUNNABLE only after start() is called.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. AWT components are heavyweight because they depend on native peer components.
II. Swing components are lightweight and are written in pure Java.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: AWT uses the operating system's native peers, so its components are heavyweight. Swing draws its own components in Java, so they are lightweight.

questions.q: Which package is imported automatically into every Java program without an explicit import statement?
questions.e: java.lang, which holds Object, String, System and the wrapper classes, is implicitly imported into every source file.

questions.q:
What is the output of the following statement?
`System.out.println(1 + 2 + "A" + 1 + 2);`
questions.e: Evaluation is left to right: 1 + 2 is 3 (int addition), then "A" makes the result a String, and the later 1 and 2 are appended as text, giving 3A12.

questions.q: Which class is the root of the class hierarchy in Java, i.e. every class is directly or indirectly its subclass?
questions.e: java.lang.Object is the superclass of all Java classes, so methods like toString() and equals() are available everywhere.

questions.q: What value is printed by `System.out.println((byte) 200);`?
questions.e: A byte holds -128 to 127. Casting 200 keeps the low 8 bits (11001000), which is -56 in two's complement.

questions.q: Which type of JDBC driver is written entirely in Java and talks to the database directly over the network (the 'thin' driver)?
questions.e: The Type 4 driver is a pure Java native-protocol driver. Type 1 is the JDBC-ODBC bridge, Type 2 uses native client libraries and Type 3 uses a middleware server.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Java.
I. A class can implement more than one interface.
II. A class can extend more than one class.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Java allows a class to extend exactly one class but to implement many interfaces, so only statement I is correct.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a checked exception in Java?
questions.e: NullPointerException is a subclass of RuntimeException, so it is unchecked. IOException, SQLException and ClassNotFoundException must be caught or declared.

questions.q: Which of the following collection classes does NOT allow duplicate elements?
questions.e: HashSet implements the Set interface, which stores unique elements only. The three List implementations allow duplicates.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an implicit object in a JSP page?
questions.e: The implicit objects are request, response, out, session, application, config, pageContext, page and exception. Cookie is an ordinary class that must be created.
